name: Bakum (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bakum (a red saltire between hooks on yellow with a blue anchor).
history: Municipal flag of Bakum; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bakum arms — saltire, hooks and anchor on yellow
